data.full_bio: Kareem leads our AI division, specializing in machine learning, natural language processing, and cybersecurity automation. He has designed and deployed advanced RAG systems, custom dataset pipelines, and LoRA fine-tuning frameworks using tools like Apple MLX, ChromaDB, and hybrid retrieval architectures. He focuses on building efficient, privacy-preserving AI systems that deliver real enterprise value.
